trigger-on-click.name: Trigger Mode: On Click
trigger-on-click.description:
ON = scare triggers on jump clicks (with a chance roll).
OFF = scare triggers at random time intervals.

click-chance.name: Click Chance (%)
click-chance.description: Percentage chance the scare fires on each jump press. Only used in click mode.

interval-min.name: Random Interval: Minimum (secs)
interval-min.description: Shortest possible time between scares. Only used in timer mode.

interval-max.name: Random Interval: Maximum (secs)
interval-max.description: Longest possible time between scares. Only used in timer mode.
